content.short: Cosmos is the first layer 0 Blockchain that enables interoperability between different systems.
content.description: Cosmos was built to let distributed ledgers communicate without relying on a centralized server. The Cosmos ecosystem, powered by the ATOM token, is designed to scale and connect blockchains so they can operate together and share information. With over $151 billion in digital assets under management, Cosmos is described as the first entirely free platform that enables interoperability among diverse systems, including Binance Chain, Terra, and Crypto.org.
